task: Phase 6 Step 2 -- Hirist offline integration design/specification only, no implementation
based_solely_on: existing, unmodified adapter architecture (source_adapter.py, source_registry.py, discover_local.py, canonical_job.py, freshness.py, location_taxonomy.py, experience_eligibility.py)

1_adapter_boundary.proposed_class: HiristAdapter(JobSourceAdapter) in scripts/hirist_adapter.py -- same existing file, extended in place
1_adapter_boundary.health_check_advisory_vs_hard_gate: undetermined -- Phase 6 only visited one search page, never the homepage, so no evidence exists either way
responsibilities_in_scope: constructing the search URL from a SearchQuery
fetching via an injectable fetcher object (mirrors NaukriAdapter(fetcher=...))
parsing primarily via the observed schema.org JSON-LD block; HTML-anchor fallback noted but not designed in detail (class-name heuristic was unreliable in Phase 6)
classifying the response into the Section 9 state set
mapping parsed data into the existing flat raw-job dict shape
declaring status/capabilities truthfully, only once demonstrated

SEARCH.basis: one successful, populated search-results page observed; not confirmed due to only one query/role/location tested

DETAIL.basis: no detail page visited in Phase 6

NATIVE_FRESHNESS.basis: no freshness parameter attempted; nothing observed indicated a native mechanism

PAGINATION.basis: rel="next" link tag directly observed in the live page's own HTML -- the only capability earning confirmed status in this table

APPLICATION_URL.basis: not visible in captured excerpt; no detail page visited; robots.txt placed no restriction but that is not confirmation of availability

COMPANY_METADATA.basis: company NAME observed in JSON-LD but excerpt cut off before any structured company object could be confirmed present or absent

SALARY.basis: not visible in captured excerpt; schema.org JobPosting defines an optional baseSalary field in general, but whether Hirist populates it was not observed

REMOTE_FILTER.basis: not tested at all in Phase 6

LOCATION_FILTER.basis: explicitly NOT marked confirmed despite temptation to do so -- the page's own canonical tag dropped the locations query parameter used in the request, ambiguous evidence the parameter may be silently ignored; no differing baseline request was ever compared

role.proposed_mapping: /search/<role-slug>-jobs path segment, slug transform analogous to naukri_adapter.py's _slugify()
role.status: observed URL shape returned real results for the one role tested; slug transform function itself is proposed, not separately re-verified for other roles

location.status: proposed only -- Phase 6 sent this parameter but never confirmed it changes results; a dedicated live comparison would be needed, not authorized by this design

experience_years.status: no evidence of an experience-filter URL parameter observed or sought

exclude_keywords.status: no Hirist-side mechanism observed or presumed, same as the LinkedIn design's conclusion

max_job_age_days.status: NATIVE_FRESHNESS unconfirmed; silently unsupported until/unless confirmed, matching existing None-means-unrestricted fallback discipline

extra.proposed_mapping: reserved escape hatch, e.g. extra['hirist_search_url'], same pattern as naukri_adapter.py's extra['naukri_search_url']

3_search_mapping.pagination_as_search_input: not a SearchQuery field today for any adapter; see Section 6

4_json_ld_extraction_design.type_observed: schema.org ItemList (and a separate BreadcrumbList, not job-listing data)

job_level_fields_actually_observed.name: observed but only partially -- combined company+title string in one captured fragment (e.g. 'Verint - Senior ...'), truncated by the 4000-character capture bound

fields_not_captured_therefore_unknown: structured company field beyond the plain-text name (e.g. hiringOrganization object)
4_json_ld_extraction_design.name_field_delimiter_assumption: the one observed example suggests a ' - ' delimiter between company and title, but this is a single, truncated data point, NOT confirmed as a general reliable convention
4_json_ld_extraction_design.design_principle: fail closed (raise a parse error) rather than guess a split point when the delimiter pattern doesn't match cleanly -- consistent with this project's existing fail-loud-don't-guess discipline
4_json_ld_extraction_design.recommended_follow_up_not_performed: a fresh, separately-authorized single live pass capturing the complete JSON-LD payload (no 4000-character bound) before any parser is written against assumed structure

company.proposed: parsed from JSON-LD name string's presumed delimited prefix

title.proposed: parsed from the same name string's remainder

location.proposed: unknown at per-item level; fallback to query's own location input only if explicitly logged as a fallback, not real extraction

work_model.proposed: defaults to empty string -> WorkModel.UNKNOWN, the existing safe default

job_url.proposed: unknown -- no per-item URL field confirmed in JSON-LD fragment; 20 HTML anchors counted but hrefs not extracted

posted_date.proposed: unknown; if confirmed later, passed through as-is to existing freshness.classify_freshness()

jd_text.proposed: unknown, likely only on an unvisited detail page

mandatory_skills_preferred_skills.proposed: empty lists (existing default) unless a skills-bearing field is confirmed

experience_min_months.proposed: omitted unless a numeric source field is confirmed

6_pagination.mechanism: directly observed rel="next" link tag, href pattern ?page=N
6_pagination.first_page: constructed search URL with no page parameter (implicitly page 1)
6_pagination.next_page_detection: parse response HTML for <link rel="next" href="...">; if present, that href is the next page
stopping_condition: rel="next" absent from a fetched page
a page returns zero new job items (defensive)
6_pagination.duplicate_protection: adapter-local tracking of job identifiers seen within a single search() call, in ADDITION to (not instead of) the existing, unmodified discover_local.deduplicate()
6_pagination.maximum_page_safety_limit: no specific number proposed -- explicit, deferred implementation decision, no evidence yet about reasonable result-set sizes
6_pagination.interaction_with_existing_searchquery_li: would be the FIRST adapter-level pagination loop in this project (Naukri is page-1-only by design) -- a genuine, non-trivial architecture addition requiring its own explicit review at implementation time

7_freshness.existing_pipeline_capability: freshness.classify_freshness() already performs post-retrieval classification of any posted_date text into HOT/FRESH/AGING/OLD/UNKNOWN, entirely independent of whether the source supports a native date filter

8_robots_policy_boundary.reason: Terms of Service were not read or verified in Phase 6 or this step

mapping.condition: real, non-empty JSON-LD ItemList with items
valid page but numberOfItems: 0 / empty itemListElement
login wall / access-denied / explicit block phrase
ambiguous page, no clear result or block signal
mapping.behavior: AdapterBlockedError with BlockReason.UNKNOWN_BLOCK -- never silently reinterpreted as empty

mapping.condition: JSON-LD missing, malformed, or unexpected shape
mapping.behavior: AdapterTimeoutError, skips this one query only

mapping.condition: pagination failure (missing rel=next, malformed next URL)
mapping.behavior: treated as no-more-pages unless first page itself fails to parse

scenarios: missing fields (name+position only, the one confirmed-minimal shape observed)
duplicate jobs (within page and across pages)
malformed next URL (unparseable or off-domain href)
robots/policy metadata (Crawl-delay parsing, decoupled from live fetching)
schema changes (ItemList replaced by bare array, or name replaced by structured fields)

conditions_all_required: policy/Terms review -- Hirist's actual Terms of Service reviewed and understood
permitted automated access established -- documented basis for this project's specific intended use
rate/crawl-delay handling -- explicit, implemented minimum delay honoring Crawl-delay: 10 as a floor
offline parser fixtures -- all 11 Section 10 scenarios implemented and passing
adapter tests -- URL construction, SearchQuery mapping, error/status mapping green
one controlled, authorized live validation (single query)
production safety verification -- DB SHA/row-count checks before and after every live step
regression suite -- full existing suite plus new Hirist tests green, proof no other adapter changed
source health behavior -- health_check() advisory-vs-hard-gate question explicitly resolved with evidence

mechanism: candidate finds a Hirist job themselves, supplies URL via existing data/inbox/job_input.txt / scripts/add_job.py (SOURCE: HIRIST already a valid free-text value)
normalization: existing, unmodified discover_local.normalize_job() handles it identically
deduplication: existing (source, job_id) identity via job_id_from_url() already prevents duplicate entry
scoring: existing, unmodified score_job() scores it identically
application tracking: existing jobs/candidate_job_matches schema and status lifecycle already support it
